I know you said you can't get into Type-0, but how is it as a game? I honestly know nothing about it.

There's an open world to explore. It has random encounters out there. The story is broken up into missions, but you'll have the opportunity to venture around once in a while, but not always. You'll have a large roster of characters to manage (14), each with their own strengths and weaknesses. You can swap between all 14 characters mid battle, though based on where I was up to, I couldn't imagine you ever needing to do that except just to level each of them up evenly. For me personally, it felt like too much.

Combat looks flashy for its time. It's real time and free roaming - more along the lines of the Tales or Star Ocean series than traditional FF combat, except with skills assigned to face buttons rather than direction+button. I found the movement to be a bit clunky. I had a bit of trouble with camera controls with the right stick too. Here's some footage of a start battle.

Then there's the overworld battles where it sort of plays like an RTS game. Here's some footage from the overworld battles.. I felt this could've been done much better. But then again, this is an old game, so maybe I'm being far too harsh.

As for story, it's true when people say its story is pretty dark. The intro shows that pretty well.

Other people obviously liked it, hence the HD remake. But it just didn't have that FF polish to it for me. I hate to admit it, but I think it's because I played it too late and I just can't seem to appreciate it while ignoring the fact its an older game.

That was very informative, thanks! I think the 14 characters would be overwhelming for me. I'd feel the need to level them all up, but laziness would probably get the better of me. The gameplay footage looks interesting, there was so much going on in the RTS video.
